data.title: Red-whiskered bulbul added to no-hunting list
data.description: National parks officials have stepped up efforts to protect the red-whiskered bulbul by adding the species to the list of wildlife that may not be hunted in 40 additional no-hunting areas in Thailand.

data.title: Kamphaeng Phet school shooter faces several charges
data.description: The teenage student who fired multiple shots at his school in Kamphaeng Phet province faces several charges while the school is closed for two days for safety revisions.

data.title: Bangkok data centre cited for unlawful fuel storage
data.description: About 200,000 litres of fuel stockpiled without permission have been removed from a data centre on Rama IX Road in Bangkok, with authorities saying they will pursue charges under Fuel Control Act.

data.title: Thailand’s ‘Jurassic Park’ shines light on dinosaur evolution
data.description: KHON KAEN - A dinosaur statue stands guard outside a temple, a hint at the ancient giants buried deep in the earth below making up northeastern Thailand’s “dinosaur rush”.

data.title: 1,520 electric buses set for rollout
data.description: The Bangkok Mass Transit Authority (BMTA) is preparing 1,520 electric buses to replace ageing vehicles, with deliveries expected to begin in March 2027.

data.title: 151 arrested in e-cigarette blitz
data.description: Cyber police arrested 151 suspects and seized more than 140 million baht over the past year in a crackdown on illegal e-cigarette networks.

data.title: Police seize fake memory cards
data.description: PATHUM THANI: Police have seized 16,245 counterfeit memory cards after complaints that fake products sold online caused severe damage to customers' data and computer systems.

data.title: BMA targets protection of mature trees
data.description: <p>The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) is stepping up efforts to expand and protect the capital's green spaces by introducing a "heritage tree" designation for valuable mature trees.</p>

data.title: Data gap clouds fate of wild bears
data.description: <p>A lack of reliable data on Thailand's wild bears is hampering efforts to track population declines and protect the animals as threats to their survival intensify.</p>

data.title: DSI serves summons on PP's Somchart
data.description: <p>The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) has successfully served a summons on People's Party (PP) MP for Phuket Somchart Techathavorncharoen, ordering him to give a statement next Monday in connection with an investigation into suspected nominee arrangements involving property companies in Phuket.</p>

data.title: Fire-damaged site sealed for debris clean-up
data.description: <p>Authorities have declared the area surrounding the fire-damaged Khlong Thom Centre building a restricted fire zone as they move in to dismantle debris.</p>

data.title: Bulbul breeding allowed, trapping banned
data.description: <p>The removal of Thailand's red-whiskered bulbul (nok krong hua juk) from the protected wildlife list does not allow people to trap the birds in the wild, Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin stressed.</p>

data.title: DSI officers face investigation over exam fraud links
data.description: <p>Justice Minister Pol Lt Gen Rutthapon Naowarat has ordered an investigation into two Department of Special Investigation (DSI) officers allegedly linked to local-government exam fraud, while People's Party MP Rangsiman Rome examines possible wider political involvement.</p>

data.title: Migrant group urges law to protect fishing workers
data.description: <p>The Migrant Working Group (MWG) has submitted a proposed marine fishing labour protection bill to the People's Party (PP), seeking parliamentary action against exploitation and forced labour.</p>

data.title: Court revives NBTC chief's qualification case
data.description: <p>The Supreme Administrative Court has overturned a lower court's refusal to hear a challenge by the chairman of the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) against the NBTC selection committee's ruling on his qualifications.</p>

data.title: Pheu Thai dismisses coalition fears
data.description: <p>Pheu Thai Party (PT) leader Julapun Amornvivat has dismissed concerns over government instability, saying a dinner planned for coalition leaders on Sunday is intended to improve communication and coordinate government work, not prepare for a no-confidence debate.</p>

data.title: Parties agree on initial House targets
data.description: <p>The opposition has named Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and Digital Economy and Society Minister Chaichanok Chidchob as initial no-confidence targets over concerns about government accountability and policy implementation.</p>

data.title: Low-carbon shift 'a growth engine'
data.description: <p>The low-carbon transition should be treated as a new growth engine for Thailand rather than an environmental obligation, Joint Standing Committee on Commerce, Industry and Banking (JSCCIB) co-chairman Payong Srivanich said on Wednesday.</p>

data.title: Households to face insurance survey
data.description: <p>The Interior Ministry has ordered a nationwide survey of households without house numbers by Sept 15 to support a planned national disaster insurance system covering about 30 million households.</p>

data.title: Thais, Singapore deepen ties
data.description: <p>Thailand and Singapore have agreed to deepen cooperation in four key areas covering energy, investment, defence and regional affairs.</p>

data.title: US sailors warmly welcomed in Pattaya
data.description: More than 5,000 US Navy personnel from the USS Abraham Lincoln have begun making their way into Pattaya, where they are expected to pour about 100 million baht into the local economy during five days of long-overdue shore leave.

data.title: Cabinet changes location of Korat floral expo
data.description: The cabinet has agreed to change the venue for an international floral exhibition in Nakhon Ratchasima, a decision that has shocked and angered residents.

data.title: Accused agent for corporate ‘mule accounts’ arrested
data.description: A woman accused of acting as an agent for a major corporate mule-account network, backed by a Chinese financier, has been arrested in Bangkok. Police say accounts supplied by the network had been linked to more than 27 fraud cases.

data.title: Teen gunman held at Kamphaeng Phet school
data.description: Police detained a 14-year-old boy on Wednesday after he entered a secondary school in Kamphaeng Phet and fired a pistol. No injuries were reported.

data.title: Bangkok halts new data centre approvals
data.description: No more licences will be issued for new data centres in Bangkok, governor Chadchart Sittipunt said on Wednesday, responding to growing concerns about potential negative impacts associated with the facilities.

data.title: Passenger voices fear over 'ghost mask’ inside ride-hail car
data.description: A ride-hail passenger took to social media to raise concerns over safety after an unsettling experience in which they found a frightening human-like mask inside the vehicle.

data.title: Mpox, Covid-19 cases continue to rise
data.description: New cases of Mpox and Covid-19 continue to rise since June with the presence of a severer mpox strain and a low fatality rate for Covid-19, according to the Department of Disease Control.

data.title: Khao Kheow Open Zoo to celebrate beloved hippo Mae Mali's 61st birthday
data.description: CHON BURI -Khao Kheow Open Zoo has prepared a special celebration for much-loved Mae Mali, or Mother Mali, Thailand’s oldest hippopotamus, as she marks her 61st birthday on Sept 8.

data.title: Cabinet decides to change location of Korat floral expo
data.description: The Cabinet has agreed to change the venue for an international floral exhibition in Nakhon Ratchasima, a decision that has shocked residents.

data.title: US aircraft carrier approaches Thai port after months at sea
data.description: LAEM CHABANG — A US aircraft carrier at the centre of controversy over conditions on board approached the Thai coast on Wednesday for its first port call in nine months.

data.title: Chinese arrested for illegal travel from Cambodia to Malaysia via Thailand
data.description: CHUMPHON: Highway police arrested five Chinese men and two Thais for carrying no legal travel documents, in this southern province on Saturday night.
